text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A repeatedly at a gain felt rewarding, but a winning position alone is not a reason to sell; decide based on its future risk and return.","My account value fluctuated even as I realized gains, so judge decisions by the portfolio as a whole rather than by locked-in wins in individual stocks.","Past price moves do not predict future moves; avoid extrapolating Stock A’s rise and keep decisions grounded in risk, diversification, and current information."]}
